column1: # Post-game ending sequence: Jenna and Kraden adrift, then Alex arrives.

column3: Kraden... how long\ncan we drift without\nfinding land?{end_wait}
Longer than I thought.\nBut I have no idea\nwhere we're drifting.{end_wait}
You want to eat?\nAt a time like this?{end_wait}
If Felix were here,\nhe'd know what to do.\nWouldn't he?{end_wait}
I don't know where\nFelix is.{pause_20_skippable} I saw the\nVenus beacon burning.{end_wait}
The shore broke apart\nafter the beacon lit.\nWhat if he was there?{end_wait}
I wish I knew,\n{actor_name:6}. I'd tell you\nif I did.{end_wait}
We still don't know\nwhere {actor_name:5} is.{pause_20_skippable} But\nwe cannot give up.{end_wait}
And {actor_name:1}...\nHe was heading for\nVenus too. Is he safe?{end_wait}
If I could see\n{actor_name:1} and {actor_name:5}\njust once more...{end_wait}
Come with me.\nThere's something\nI want you to see.{end_wait}
They're alive...\nFelix and Sheba.\nBoth of them are alive!{end_wait}
